content: Grapheme is atomic meaningful unit in writing system of any languages. Since, Nepali language is highly morphologically inflectional, we compared grapheme-level representation with character-level representation to evaluate its effect. For example, in character-level embedding, each character of a word npAl results into n + + p + A + l has its own embedding. However, in grapheme level, a word npAl is clustered into graphemes, resulting into n + pA + l. Here, each grapheme has its own embedding. This grapheme-level embedding results good scores on par with character-level embedding in highly inflectional languages like Nepali, because graphemes also capture syntactic information similar to characters. We created grapheme clusters using uniseg package which is helpful in unicode text segmentations.
